acceptance: Explorer vitest, jest-axe and Playwright chromium suites green with no test logic changes beyond selectors for the shared header
Deep-link, back/forward, query-string restore and worker/WASM recovery verified by e2e against the assembled site
Docs and blog pages load zero Explorer/DuckDB bytes (network assertion)
Loading/error states pass axe and announce via live region

description:
results-explorer/src/App.tsx owns the routing (preact-router, absolute /results/ paths) and the full layout.

Work:
- Extract the header and frame into the shared shell component from astro-site-22, consumed by both the site and the Explorer.
- Scope or remove Explorer global CSS so it cannot leak into or be overridden by site CSS.
- Keep query-string state, nested-route deep links, the hard-coded /results/ links (resultsNav.ts, MetaLeaderboard.tsx, headerContract.ts), the DuckDB fetch path /results/data/results.duckdb, and worker/WASM asset paths.
- Give loading and error states accessible names and live regions.
- The Explorer stays a separate build artifact pinned by its own SHA and digest (D12). The site build consumes its dist; it does not rebuild Explorer source.

No changes to queries, metrics, admission or withdrawal logic.
